claims.summary: Characteristic zero, lambda=3/2, N>=4. In the caterpillar a_j=c_j eps^(j-1) of the separated pair space (generic c_j), assuming the minimality condition for the near cluster a_3..a_N, the normalized span in S=eps T converges on compacts of C minus {0,-1/c_2} to the pullback of the binary face of N roots under t=1+2c_2 S; so the Weierstrass points with |T|~1/eps are binom(N-2,2) simple points converging to (t_0-1)/(2c_2), Q_r(t_0)=0. By inversion the same holds at |T|~eps^(-(N-2)) for the reversed caterpillar.
claims.assessment: Conditional on the minimality condition (as prop:cube-caterpillar-outer-components); blockwise limits (near-near, visible-near by Schur valuations, far-near with a common factor tending to 1, far-visible), affine identification with the binary face, Hurwitz. Predicted exponents match the saved N=5,6 runs at all printed decimals.
claims.rationale: Identifies two rigid components of the caterpillar as binary faces with simple points; reduces the caterpillar to its middle components and necks.

relationships: Minimality condition, Schur valuation argument and inversion.
